rejects.event: An Italian cola named MoleCola entered production and quickly spread in popularity.
rejects.quote: In recent years, another trademark drink of the city is MoleCola, an Italian cola that entered production in 2012 and quickly spread both in Italy and outside its native country.
rejects.why: The source quote states MoleCola entered production in 2012, but does not state the year it 'quickly spread in popularity' (only mentioning 'In recent years').
